sections: travel from one place to another. Mia's journey ends at a hotel past the park.
A case with a handle used for carrying clothes when traveling. My clothes are in the suitcase.
To put things into a bag or case for a journey. I pack my bag before the trip.
travel light · /ˈtrævəl laɪt/ · phrase · Phrase · New
Travel with only a small amount of luggage. I take one small bag because I like to travel light.
have a good trip · /hæv ə ɡʊd trɪp/ · phrase · Phrase · New
A friendly wish for someone to enjoy a journey. Have a good trip! See you on Monday.

articulation.label: journey
articulation.alt: journey: /dʒ/ → /ɝ/ → /n/ → /i/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /dʒ/: Brief closure and release, with voice.
/ɝ/: Bunch the tongue for American r; no tip contact.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
